item.title: Re: Hi! I am thinking of making an SCP! Please tell me your opinion. Thank you!
item.content:encoded:
hey i would recomend that you use the template that they provide to use in this forum.

1) the idea sounds good. just that there are a lot of mannequin SCP's and this could get drowned out by all of them.

2) this sounds a lot like the revised version of SCP 173, as in that one it duplicates itself. and this could be seen as very similair. except this one only attacks in the morning and not at night. so maybe include something that makes it stand out. or have it have no defined form, like everyone that looks at it sees something different? idk.

3)I'm not much of a critique so take my advice with a grain of salt. i would just hate this to get put into the "173 remakes" pile. hope you do well and go further with your writing.

item.title: Hi! I am thinking of making an SCP! Please tell me your opinion. Thank you!
item.content:encoded: A mannequin, approximately 2 feet tall. It's bodily figure resembles a mannequin. It has keen sight despite having no eyes. It is swift despite having no limbs. It shows aggression at the morning, and immobility at night. It can move it's head, and torso. Every time it attacks a subject, it starts to split open it's head, it will show the inside the head of the mannequin, filled will daggers. And it will kill the subject by biting. It can make duplicates of itself, using it's body. The instance will grow next to it's head, torso or lower part of it. The instance can break free from the mannequin, and act the same. It doesn't have any specific time when it will make it's duplicate.
